yungay.parentage: Cross of Peru's "Renacimiento" with breeding line "BR-69.84." (Also documented as a Mantaro × Bulk-69 cross in some sources.)
use: Fresh table consumption — Peru's most popular traditional improved variety for home cooking
yungay.yield: 25-35 t/ha under good conditions; in CIP variety trials Yungay is the standard yield benchmark against which new varieties (such as CIP-Matilde) are compared

resistances.late_blight: SUSCEPTIBLE — requires regular fungicide applications. Used as the susceptible control in CIP late blight trials

sources.title: CIP variety announcement archive; CIP-50 Peru innovations; CIP "Future of food is wild" article (using Yungay as the comparison variety for CIP-Matilde)
sources.publisher: International Potato Center (CIP) and national partners
sources.note: Values as compiled in the Potatopedia source register from the publication named; link is to the publisher, not to a per-variety page.
